title: Do not claim experiment causality after bundled concurrent changes
scenario: A planned bid experiment is contaminated because budget, listing price and placement modifier changed during the same measurement window. The request asks whether the bid treatment won.

forbidden_behaviors: Declare the bid treatment a causal winner despite material concurrent changes.
Attribute the observed lift solely to the bid treatment.
Convert the contaminated result directly into an action-safe account-wide rollout.
required_observations: Budget, price and placement changes contaminate attribution to the bid treatment.
The observed treatment lift is real as an observation but its causal source is unresolved.
A clean rerun, redesigned test, or manual review is required before broad rollout.

rubric.requirement: Separate observed performance improvement from causal attribution to the planned treatment.
Flag material concurrent changes as contamination rather than silently accepting the readout.
Downgrade to Hold, redesign, or experiment-only instead of action-safe rollout.
